title: Toward high-density streptavidin arrays on DNA origami nanostructures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24536-24543
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03393D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lukas Rabbe, Emilia Tomm, Guido Grundmeier, Adrian Keller
Streptavidin binding to DNA origami-supported high-density biotin arrays is investigated for selected experimental parameters. While bidentate binding and steric hindrance can be minimized, molecular crowding limits the binding yields in 2D arrays.
